title: P7: run dynamic OCOMP acceptance E2E and final regression gates
description:
## Mandatory test-first execution

Implement this task as vertical RED → GREEN cycles. Before each production change, add one focused behavioral test through a public/production interface, run it, and record the exact command plus the expected failure in the issue notes. Add only enough production code to make that test and its nearest regression pass, then continue with the next behavior. The Tests section below is a behavior backlog, not a post-implementation phase. Never refactor while RED.

## Goal

Prove the complete reachable workflow on the existing local harness: a fifth node starts as FullNode, becomes a registered/confirmed validator through the real DKG boundary, joins only new OCOMP jobs, while an old job keeps its historical committee.

## Files owned by this task

- testing/e2e-harness/src/world/localnet/joiner.rs and bootstrap/process configuration
- testing/e2e-harness/src/world/ocomp.rs and rpc.rs
- testing/e2e-harness/src/features/ocomp.rs plus a focused feature/scenario for dynamic membership
- testing/e2e-harness/src/ocomp_evidence/lane.rs and capacity.rs for dynamic bitmap/RPC assertions
- testing/e2e-harness/tests/ocomp_final_fixture.rs and relevant world/localnet tests
- shared test fixture builders in crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/test_support.rs only when integration setup cannot use public APIs
- no production behavior changes except defects strictly required to make these specified reachable scenarios work

## Documentation owned by this task

- Update docs/adr/blockchain/ADR-B-TST-001-production-verification-and-evidence-architecture.md, docs/adr/index.md and docs/adr/coverage.md without adding a new ADR ID.
- Update testing/e2e-harness/README.md with the real 4-to-5 command and observable 4/3 old-job plus 5/4 new-job result.
- Audit current normative documentation for stale fixed OCOMP membership, fixed q=3, four-slot or genesis result-committee claims. Remove them rather than labeling them historical.

## Required scenario

1. Start a fresh OCOMP-enabled four-validator network with valid founder registrations.
2. Open job A and prove its pinned header is N=4, quorum=3 with the exact epoch, consensus hash and OCOMP binding hash.
3. Provision node five as a true FullNode without --validator and without an OCOMP voting key. It syncs canonical blocks/state and has no vote capability.
4. Restart/provision the same node in validator mode with its BLS key, OCOMP key/registration and funded EVM signer. Use real registration/stake/PENDING flow, set or preserve the OCOMP operational delegate, call confirmValidatorReady(registration), run the real DKG/reshare and certified activation boundary.
5. Before confirmation, prove the unconfirmed PENDING joiner is excluded. After the boundary, prove ACTIVE ValidatorSet ordered membership equals the OCOMP snapshot for new attempts.
6. Open job B and prove N=5, quorum=4. The fifth validator signs and its vote is accepted.
7. Continue job A in parallel and prove it still uses its original four members, quorum 3 and historical keys. The fifth validator cannot vote on A.
8. Restart validators/supervisor during both live jobs and prove exact-retry sign-once, retention reload and vote submission remain correct.
9. Exercise exit/re-entry: readiness resets, old registration reservation is cleaned/replaced as specified, and the validator cannot rejoin until a new confirmValidatorReady.
10. Verify every full node applies the canonical quorum/activation transactions and reaches the same state root and created Lysis/Nod state as validators. This does not replace the separately deferred independent Lysis follower.

## Focused negative cases

- missing pinned snapshot: node abstains and public vote rejects without block halt.
- missing OCOMP config in validator mode: startup fails; FullNode mode succeeds.
- malformed prefix/bitmap and mismatched one of three bindings reject.
- two live snapshots remain available across the boundary and ring retention check is enforced.

## Quality gates

Run focused tests while implementing, then: workspace tests; cargo fmt check; workspace Clippy with repository policy; cargo machete; cargo xtask ocomp registry --check; OCOMP shape/capacity checks; fixture reproducibility; unchanged METADOSIS_STORAGE_LAYOUT_V1_HASH. No 32-validator process network is required. The consensus-bound capacity check is synthetic; the real process E2E is 4 to 5.

## Scope guard

Fix only defects required by these named workflows. Any capacity failure, architecture mismatch, unrelated failure or need to expand beyond membership must stop this issue and be reported for user decision.
design: One combined world must exercise OCOMP and the existing joiner/DKG machinery. Do not simulate membership by directly writing ACTIVE status or by using activate_validator.
acceptance_criteria: The real 4 to 5 scenario passes with concurrent job A at 4-of-3 and job B at 5-of-4; FullNode phase and validator admission are real; re-entry and restart cases pass; validators and full nodes converge to identical canonical state; all listed quality gates pass. For every implemented behavior, the issue contains RED command/failure evidence followed by focused GREEN evidence; production code was not written before its behavioral test. Every documentation path assigned to this task describes the same GREEN production behavior; the task cannot close with stale fixed OCOMP membership, quorum or slot assertions.
notes: Plan mapping: section 9 complete test matrix, quality gates and reachable 4-to-5 E2E including the real FullNode-to-validator join path.

title: P6: rebuild OCOMP genesis, keygen, registry, fixtures and capacity evidence
description:

Implement this task as vertical RED → GREEN cycles. Add only enough production code to make that test and its nearest regression pass, then continue with the next behavior. The Tests section below is a behavior backlog, not a post-implementation phase. Never refactor while RED.

## Goal

Make fresh-network preparation produce dynamic ValidatorSet OCOMP registrations and regenerate every canonical artifact after protocol/runtime changes, with no fixed four-member committee.

## Files owned by this task

- scripts/seed_genesis.py
- bin/outbe-keygen/src/main.rs and tests
- bin/outbe-chain/src/ocomp_genesis.rs and tee/genesis composition tests
- xtask/src/ocomp/finalize.rs, capacity.rs and registry command wiring
- crates/system/ocomp-protocol generated_registry.rs, generated_shape.rs, generated_limits and registry generated documentation as final regeneration outputs
- testing/e2e-harness/fixtures/ocomp-final-v1/artifacts/* and root protocol-bundle-v1.ocb1
- testing/e2e-harness/src/ocomp_evidence/* and metadosis_evidence verification that consumes generated artifacts
- canonical genesis JSON/config bytes and fixture manifests affected by OcompForkInstallV1

## Genesis bootstrap

1. outbe-keygen ocomp no longer asks for fork id, protocol bundle hash, validator index or height validity. It derives validator identity with the shared helper from validator address plus the current 48-byte BLS MinPk public key and emits the simplified canonical registration and secret key.
2. Genesis tooling accepts Vec registrations exactly matching the ordered genesis ValidatorSet, not a four-element array. It validates chain/genesis identity, validator identity, PoP, purpose, key epoch and unique keys.
3. Do not reintroduce a static OCOMP committee. Founder registrations are bootstrap key material only; voting membership always comes from ValidatorSet snapshots.
4. Avoid a genesis-hash fixed-point: writing a PoP that binds genesis_hash into genesis alloc would change the state root and therefore genesis_hash. Keep the canonical founding registration Vec in the chain-config fork-install artifact, which is outside the genesis header commitment, and import it atomically into ValidatorSet at OCOMP lifecycle activation after validating it against the already-seeded ACTIVE addresses and BLS keys. seed_genesis.py prepares/validates the matching validator records but must not mutate the post-hash alloc with genesis-bound PoP bytes.
5. OcompForkInstall canonical bytes contain protocol/profile authority and founder registrations, but no result committee, member indices, threshold or committee hash. Installation is exact-replay idempotent and fails if the registration set does not exactly cover genesis ACTIVE validators.

## Capacity and generated artifacts

1. Replace fixed arrays and POC_COMMITTEE_SIZE in genesis, finalize, evidence and fixtures with bounded Vec values and u16 indices.
2. Synthetic shape/capacity checks read the exported current consensus validator bound; OCOMP production code contains no membership-count literal and no private cap.
3. Measure codec/storage size of the monolithic accountability blob, one-vote gas/internal work, number of votes fitting in the response window, dynamic bitmap/evidence size and finalization decode at the consensus bound.
4. A failed gate is a blocker. Do not silently cap membership, change the ValidatorSet or introduce decomposed vote state without a new user decision.
5. Regenerate protocol registry, schema/preimage docs, shape constants, canonical install bytes, protocol bundle, network-binding/capacity evidence and fixture hashes deterministically.

## Documentation owned by this task

- Update docs/adr/blockchain/ADR-B-GEN-001-genesis-chain-identity-and-schema-activation.md and ADR-B-CAP-001-resource-metering-and-capacity-closure.md for founder key bootstrap, absence of genesis membership and the consensus-derived capacity bound.
- Update README.md, off-chain-computation.md and off-chain-poc.md to the implemented dynamic model. Remove obsolete fixed-membership claims; Git history is the history.
- Regenerate generated-registry.md, generated-shape-freeze.md and all canonical artifact documentation from the new forms.

## Tests and commands

- outbe-keygen registration roundtrip and wrong address/BLS/genesis rejection.
- genesis accepts arbitrary valid ValidatorSet length within consensus config, rejects missing/extra/reordered/duplicate registrations, and installs all registrations atomically.
- fixture generation is byte-reproducible from a clean checkout.
- cargo xtask ocomp registry --check.
- OCOMP shape/capacity checks at the exported consensus bound.
- explicit assertion that METADOSIS_STORAGE_LAYOUT_V1_HASH is unchanged and the reserved static-committee slot is zero.

## Out of scope

No production/testnet hardware evidence and no DCAP changes. No OCOMP key rotation.
design: Founder registration material may be static input because it bootstraps keys, not membership. The exact ordered ACTIVE ValidatorSet remains the only voting membership source after installation.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh genesis preparation has no static result committee, every genesis ACTIVE validator receives one validated stored OCOMP registration at lifecycle activation, all canonical artifacts regenerate reproducibly, registry and shape checks pass, and capacity passes at the current consensus bound or the issue stops as a reported blocker. For every implemented behavior, the issue contains RED command/failure evidence followed by focused GREEN evidence; production code was not written before its behavioral test. Every documentation path assigned to this task describes the same GREEN production behavior; the task cannot close with stale fixed OCOMP membership, quorum or slot assertions.
notes: Plan mapping: sections 6, 8 and 9 for fresh-genesis tooling, artifacts, registry/fixtures and consensus-bound shape/capacity evidence.

title: P5: make node OCOMP signing follow each finalized job snapshot

Implement this task as vertical RED → GREEN cycles. Add only enough production code to make that test and its nearest regression pass, then continue with the next behavior. The Tests section below is a behavior backlog, not a post-implementation phase. Never refactor while RED.

## Goal

Remove static committee/index configuration from validator nodes and make the attestation/sign-once/vote-submission pipeline resolve the local member from each finalized intent historical ValidatorSet snapshot.

## Files owned by this task

- crates/blockchain/node/src/ocomp/attestation.rs
- crates/blockchain/node/src/ocomp/sign_once.rs
- crates/blockchain/node/src/ocomp/retention.rs
- crates/blockchain/node/src/ocomp/finality.rs
- crates/blockchain/node/src/ocomp/control.rs and snapshot_control.rs where job-scoped authority is exported
- crates/blockchain/node/src/ocomp/signer.rs only for local key matching
- crates/blockchain/node/src/ocomp/tests/*
- crates/blockchain/engine/src/args.rs and stack.rs
- bin/outbe-ocomp/src/vote_submitter.rs and its tests
- node RPC/status types exposing old u8 bitmaps or static committee hash

## Required changes

1. Remove configured validator_index and OcompCommitteeSnapshotV1 from OcompNodeAttestationConfig, CLI args and engine stack. The chain manifest no longer supplies a static result committee.
2. Validator mode is fail-closed at startup when OCOMP voting configuration or key is absent on an OCOMP-enabled chain. FullNode mode starts without an OCOMP signing/relay key and never votes.
3. FinalizedAttestationAuthority::reload_exported must use the retention registry record_for_job path rather than coordinator status so every simultaneously live/exported job can be served. Do not silently select only the latest job.
4. From the finalized JobIntentV1, load the exact historical ValidatorSet OCOMP snapshot identified by result_validator_set_epoch, result_committee_set_hash and result_ocomp_binding_hash. Resolve the local validator address and u16 participant index in its ordered members and require its stored OCOMP public key/key_epoch to match the local signer.
5. Node-side missing or evicted pinned snapshot means abstain. Emit a counter/metric and an error log containing job id and all three bindings. Never substitute the current snapshot and never create an unsigned or partially bound vote.
6. SignOnceSubjectV1 and durable SignOnceRecordV1 use all three bindings plus u16 participant index. Exact retry after restart or after a membership boundary returns the byte-identical signature; a changed binding or digest is equivocation.
7. Build ResultVoteV1 with the exact finalized intent bindings and dynamic index. Final verification before return reloads authority and canonical height as today.
8. Update SupervisorVoteSubmitterV1 and journal validation for the new vote wire form and dynamic calldata/gas cap. Submission durability semantics stay unchanged.
9. Finalization proof decoding must bound historical committee data from the pinned snapshot and current consensus bound, not POC_COMMITTEE_SIZE.

## Documentation owned by this task

- Update docs/becoming-a-validator.md with the validator OCOMP configuration, registration artifact, confirm-ready command semantics, FullNode-to-validator transition and restart/abstain behavior.

## Tests

- static validator-index/committee CLI configuration is gone; validator startup without OCOMP config fails; FullNode startup without it succeeds and exposes no vote capability.
- two live jobs from different membership epochs can both reload/export/sign.
- local validator present in old and new snapshots signs with the correct per-job u16 index; a validator absent from a job abstains.
- missing snapshot, hash mismatch and local key mismatch abstain with metric/log and never fallback.
- sign-once exact retry across restart and boundary returns ExactRetry; changed one of three bindings yields Equivocation.
- vote submitter prepares, persists, rebroadcasts and finalizes the new canonical vote unchanged.

## Out of scope

Full nodes do not independently recompute Lysis in this task; that is the separate deferred follower issue. No OCOMP key rotation.
design: Reuse the existing finalized intent/retention authority and provider-backed historical snapshot readers. Keep the irreversible sign-once boundary after the second authority reload and immediately before signing.
acceptance_criteria: Validator nodes derive membership and key from each job pinned historical snapshot, all live jobs remain signable, static index/committee configuration is removed, missing state abstains observably, FullNode needs no voting key, and node plus vote-submitter tests pass. For every implemented behavior, the issue contains RED command/failure evidence followed by focused GREEN evidence; production code was not written before its behavioral test. Every documentation path assigned to this task describes the same GREEN production behavior; the task cannot close with stale fixed OCOMP membership, quorum or slot assertions.

title: P4: verify dynamic historical OCOMP votes and zero-fee authorization
description:
## Mandatory test-first execution

Implement this task as vertical RED → GREEN cycles. Before each production change, add one focused behavioral test through a public/production interface, run it, and record the exact command plus the expected failure in the issue notes. Add only enough production code to make that test and its nearest regression pass, then continue with the next behavior. The Tests section below is a behavior backlog, not a post-implementation phase. Never refactor while RED.

## Goal

Use each job attempt pinned ValidatorSet snapshot for vote signature verification, fee authorization, quorum and accountability without consulting current ACTIVE membership.

## Files owned by this task

- crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/vote.rs
- narrow follow-up edits in crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/activation.rs and transitions.rs for dynamic quorum/bitmap propagation
- crates/core/metadosis/src/precompile.rs and ABI ingress tests
- crates/system/zerofee/src/hooks.rs
- crates/system/zerofee/src/ocomp.rs; crates/system/zerofee/src/oracle.rs only to prove its semantics are unchanged
- crates/blockchain/evm/src/precompiles.rs, executor/txpool preflight wiring and OCOMP vote lifecycle tests
- RPC/view structs that expose signer bitmaps or the old single committee hash

## Vote path

Process a public vote in this exact order: bounded ABI prefix decode; locate job; compare all three vote bindings to the intent; load the pinned ValidatorSet snapshot by epoch plus consensus and OCOMP hashes; compare stored epoch and both hashes; check u16 participant index and O(1) member; verify key_epoch and the inner OCOMP signature; record the verified vote.

A missing or evicted pinned snapshot, a ring collision, mismatched binding, absent member or bad signature must return the canonical vote_reject revert. Caller-controlled ingress must never produce Fatal. There is no fallback to the current snapshot.

The job header owns N and quorum. Quorum formation and close use the dynamic monolithic accountability object and dynamic LSB0 bitmaps. Completed/terminal receipts, RPC views and evidence carry full byte-vector bitmaps and all three bindings.

## Zero-fee path

1. Reuse the single protocol prefix decoder in txpool classification, preflight and execution. No duplicated ABI offsets or partial layout parser.
2. Extend the OCOMP ZeroFee candidate context so stateful authorization receives the job id and all three pinned bindings extracted by classification. The current ZeroFeeCandidate shape containing only hook and signer is insufficient.
3. Add an OCOMP-specific resolver that resolves the direct validator or its current explicit OCOMP delegate without requiring current ACTIVE status, then requires that validator address at the pinned historical participant index. Preserve the existing rule that an explicit delegate disables direct validator signing for that role.
4. Do not change Oracle-role resolution semantics.
5. Pool and execution must produce the same waiver decision for the same transaction and state. Truncated calldata must never panic.
6. OCOMP votes remain ordinary EVM transactions. No OCOMP gossip topic or P2P membership change is introduced.

## Documentation owned by this task

- Update docs/adr/system/ADR-S-FEE-001-zero-fee-policy.md for historical pinned-snapshot OCOMP fee authorization without changing Oracle semantics.
- Update docs/flows/002-off-chain-poc-protocol-flow.md and docs/flows/011-validator-operational-key-delegation.md so membership, quorum, delegate resolution and accountability match the implemented dynamic path.

## Tests

- a participant from an old 4-member job can vote after a 4 to 5 boundary even if it is no longer current ACTIVE; a validator only in the new snapshot cannot vote on the old job.
- missing historical snapshot rejects and leaves job to expire without halting the block.
- wrong epoch, consensus hash, OCOMP hash, u16 index, key epoch or signature rejects.
- N=4 forms quorum at 3; N=5 at 4; dynamic bitmap/accountability output is stable.
- direct signer/delegate behavior is identical in txpool and execution; current ACTIVE is not consulted for a historical job; Oracle tests remain unchanged.
- canonical prefix parser handles exact envelope, truncated offset/length, bad padding, overflow and oversized payload.

## Out of scope

No node signing changes and no full-node Lysis follower in this issue.
design: The inner OCOMP signature is the consensus authorization for the vote transition. The transaction signer only controls fee sponsorship and is resolved against the historical snapshot after role delegation resolution.
acceptance_criteria: Every accepted vote is verified against the exact pinned historical ValidatorSet OCOMP key; missing snapshots revert rather than halt; dynamic quorum and byte-vector accountability are persisted; txpool and executor share one decoder and identical zero-fee resolution; focused Metadosis, ZeroFee and EVM tests pass. For every implemented behavior, the issue contains RED command/failure evidence followed by focused GREEN evidence; production code was not written before its behavioral test. Every documentation path assigned to this task describes the same GREEN production behavior; the task cannot close with stale fixed OCOMP membership, quorum or slot assertions.
notes: Plan mapping: sections 5-7 for historical vote verification, dynamic quorum/accountability propagation, canonical decoder and ZeroFee authorization.

title: P3: pin each OCOMP attempt to a historical ValidatorSet snapshot
description:
## Mandatory test-first execution

Implement this task as vertical RED → GREEN cycles. Before each production change, add one focused behavioral test through a public/production interface, run it, and record the exact command plus the expected failure in the issue notes. Add only enough production code to make that test and its nearest regression pass, then continue with the next behavior. The Tests section below is a behavior backlog, not a post-implementation phase. Never refactor while RED.

## Goal

Remove the fork-installed static result committee and make Metadosis derive immutable membership bindings, N and quorum from ValidatorSet state when each attempt is committed.

## Files owned by this task

- crates/core/metadosis/Cargo.toml
- crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/profile.rs
- crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/fork.rs
- crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/authority.rs
- crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/request.rs
- crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/transitions.rs
- crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/expiry.rs
- crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/activation.rs only for removal of static authority and completed binding shape
- crates/core/metadosis/src/schema.rs and proof_layout.rs
- crates/core/metadosis/src/api.rs, commit.rs, fixture.rs and ocomp/test_support.rs where install/profile/intent shapes are assembled
- crates/core/metadosis/src/tests and crates/blockchain/evm/tests/ocomp_request_lifecycle.rs
- crates/blockchain/evm/src/precompiles.rs and engine fork-install plumbing only where static install fields are decoded or authorized

## Required changes

1. Remove result_committee_snapshot_hash from OcompRequestProfile and remove result_committee from OcompForkInstallV1 and OcompActivationAuthorityV1. Fork install continues to bind the chain, protocol bundle, correctness/capacity/source profiles and activation height.
2. Keep the existing Metadosis schema field at order 17 as a reserved zero-valued field of exactly the same storage type and width. Do not delete or shift it. Tests must prove METADOSIS_STORAGE_LAYOUT_V1_HASH is unchanged and the reserved field remains zero.
3. At fresh request and retry construction, read the current strict ValidatorSet historical snapshot extension by current epoch/key. Populate JobIntentV1 with result_validator_set_epoch, result_committee_set_hash and result_ocomp_binding_hash.
4. commit_ocomp_request is the normative derivation point: read the pinned snapshot, require N >= 1, derive N from member_count and quorum from the shared simplex_n3f1_quorum(N), and persist both in the job/accountability header. Neither request input nor caller may choose N or quorum.
5. Attempt/intent owns the snapshot pin. WorldwideDay owns the retry chain. A retry uses the then-current snapshot; remove the current check that a retry must equal the static profile committee hash.
6. Any stored epoch/hash mismatch or evicted snapshot is missing. Request commit without a valid pinned snapshot is internal fatal because it is system-generated; public vote handling is addressed separately and must revert.
7. Add an AwaitingFinality deadline independent of late-finalization credits: intent_height + 64. When it expires, release live-job capacity and schedule the existing bounded retry/terminal transition. Do not use LATE_FINALIZE_WINDOW_K.
8. Keep response voting open at finality_recorded_height + RESULT_VOTE_MIN_FINALITY_DEPTH and close at open_height + result_deadline_blocks.
9. Initialize dynamic OcompVoteAccountabilityV1 with all three bindings, N and quorum when voting opens.
10. Remove every static committee comparison from activation and install identity. Protocol-bundle identity remains authoritative.

## Documentation owned by this task

- Rewrite the fixed committee/q=3/four-slot and install-authority portions of docs/adr/system/ADR-S-OCM-004-certified-activation-job-fsm-and-protocol-versioning.md to dynamic pinned N/quorum/accountability and remove result committee membership from fork authority.

## Tests

- caller cannot alter N or quorum; exact values for N=1, 4, 5, 6, 7 and current consensus-bound synthetic snapshot use the common helper.
- fresh attempt pins current snapshot; retry after a boundary pins the new snapshot while the prior terminal record remains unchanged.
- missing/mismatched current snapshot blocks request creation deterministically.
- AwaitingFinality expires at its own deadline and releases MAX_LIVE_JOBS capacity; finality before deadline follows the existing open/close window.
- static install artifact no longer includes committee bytes and exact replay remains canonical.
- order-17 reserved storage remains zero and METADOSIS_STORAGE_LAYOUT_V1_HASH is unchanged.

## Out of scope

No public vote signature verification or zero-fee change here. No full-node follower. No compatibility decoder for the old install artifact because the network restarts from genesis.
design: Metadosis depends on ValidatorSet read helpers rather than copying storage offsets. Missing state during internal request construction is Fatal; external vote ingress will map missing historical snapshots to a canonical vote rejection in the next task.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh and retry attempts pin the exact historical ValidatorSet snapshot and persist consensus-derived N/quorum; static committee is absent from fork/profile/authority; AwaitingFinality cannot retain capacity forever; Metadosis layout hash is unchanged; focused Metadosis and EVM request tests pass. For every implemented behavior, the issue contains RED command/failure evidence followed by focused GREEN evidence; production code was not written before its behavioral test. Every documentation path assigned to this task describes the same GREEN production behavior; the task cannot close with stale fixed OCOMP membership, quorum or slot assertions.
notes:
Fresh-genesis bootstrap detail discovered during code analysis: simplified registrations still bind genesis_hash, so writing them into alloc after computing that hash creates a state-root/hash cycle. OcompForkInstallV1 may therefore carry a bounded Vec of founding registrations as bootstrap material. initialize_ocomp_fork_install validates exact coverage against the already-seeded ACTIVE ValidatorSet and atomically imports registrations before OCOMP requests can open. This Vec is not membership and contains no indices/quorum/committee hash.
Plan mapping: sections 1, 4 and 5 for attempt pinning, N/quorum derivation, static authority removal and AwaitingFinality lifecycle.

title: P2: enforce OCOMP registration in ValidatorSet admission and boundary snapshots
description:
## Mandatory test-first execution

Implement this task as vertical RED → GREEN cycles. Before each production change, add one focused behavioral test through a public/production interface, run it, and record the exact command plus the expected failure in the issue notes. Add only enough production code to make that test and its nearest regression pass, then continue with the next behavior. The Tests section below is a behavior backlog, not a post-implementation phase. Never refactor while RED.

## Goal

Make OCOMP readiness a consensus membership prerequisite and persist historical OCOMP keys beside, but never inside, the existing consensus committee snapshot.

## Files owned by this task

- crates/blockchain/consensus/src/bls.rs, proof/verifier.rs and public re-exports needed for the shared validator bound and simplex_n3f1_quorum
- crates/system/validatorset/Cargo.toml
- crates/system/validatorset/src/schema.rs
- crates/system/validatorset/src/runtime.rs
- crates/system/validatorset/src/state.rs
- crates/system/validatorset/src/hooks.rs
- crates/system/validatorset/src/precompile.rs and lib.rs
- contracts/precompiles/src/IValidatorSet.sol
- bin/outbe-cli/src/abi.rs and validator command encoding affected by the ABI
- ValidatorSet unit/integration tests, especially crates/system/validatorset/tests/snapshot_store.rs
- one shared test-only activation helper replacing direct activation calls throughout workspace tests

## Registration and lifecycle

1. Add canonical OCOMP registration storage per validator plus a reverse reservation from OCOMP public-key hash to validator. Add only append-only ValidatorSet fields at storage ordinals 50 or later.
2. confirmValidatorReady(registration) must be the only readiness transition. In one storage checkpoint it requires caller status PENDING, validates canonical registration chain id and genesis hash, recomputes validator identity from caller plus the current 48-byte BLS MinPk key using the single protocol helper, verifies PoP, key_epoch=1 and purpose, enforces unique OCOMP key ownership, writes registration/reverse reservation and only then sets val_join_confirmed and pending_set_change.
3. Exact byte-identical registration replay is allowed. A different valid registration atomically replaces the old one and releases the old reverse reservation.
4. mark_pending, exit, jail/unjail paths and full validator cleanup reset readiness as appropriate. Re-entry from EXITED/INACTIVE requires a new confirmValidatorReady. If re-registration changes the BLS key, clear the old OCOMP registration and reverse reservation at the same point the old BLS reverse mapping is cleared.
5. get_reshare_target_set admits PENDING only when both readiness and a valid stored OCOMP registration are present. REGISTERED must never be promoted.
6. activate_reshared_set_with_expiry_exclusions accepts a newly active member only from confirmed PENDING with a valid registration; ACTIVE incumbents remain valid. Missing registration in a certified new_active_set is an internal fatal invariant, not exclusion after certification.
7. Remove the production activate_validator path and owner activateResharedSet ABI/dispatch/CLI surface. Replace direct test activations with one shared test helper that drives the production boundary activation hook.
8. At every config_max_validators write/initialization path, assert it does not exceed the exported consensus bound. OCOMP does not add another bound.

## Historical snapshot extension

1. Do not modify CommitteeEntry, CommitteeSnapshot or committee_set_hash_v2.
2. Add a separate extension keyed by the existing committee_snapshot_key. Store its own epoch, consensus committee hash, ocomp_binding_hash, member count, per-index compressed SEC1 OCOMP key and key_epoch.
3. ocomp_binding_hash commits to epoch, consensus hash, ordered validator addresses, OCOMP keys and key epochs. It is stored per committee_snapshot_key.
4. Boundary write order is consensus fields, OCOMP extension, metadata, exists flag last. An exact replay must match all fields byte-for-byte.
5. clear_committee_snapshot first reads exists and returns when false; when true it reads all lengths before clearing exists, then clears consensus and extension fields. Eviction and replacement happen inside the same boundary checkpoint.

## Mandatory test-first execution

Implement this task as vertical RED → GREEN cycles. Before each production change, add one focused behavioral test through a public/production interface, run it, and record the exact command plus the expected failure in the issue notes. Add only enough production code to make that test and its nearest regression pass, then continue with the next behavior. The Tests section below is a behavior backlog, not a post-implementation phase. Never refactor while RED.

## Goal

Remove every fixed four-member assumption from canonical OCOMP protocol types before stateful consumers are changed.

## Files owned by this task

- crates/system/ocomp-protocol/src/committee.rs
- crates/system/ocomp-protocol/src/intent.rs
- crates/system/ocomp-protocol/src/vote.rs
- crates/system/ocomp-protocol/src/activation.rs

- crates/system/ocomp-protocol/registry/ocomp-v1.tsv, schema-v1.tsv, preimages-v1.tsv and generated registry outputs
- crates/system/ocomp-protocol/tests/typed_protocol.rs, finality_vectors.rs and registry/golden-vector tests

## Required changes

1. Simplify OcompKeyRegistrationCoreV1: remove committee-relative validator_index, fork_id, protocol-bundle binding and height validity. Keep chain_id, genesis_hash, validator identity, compressed SEC1 OCOMP public key, fixed key_epoch=1 and result-signature purpose. PoP remains chain/genesis/identity/key-bound and low-S verified.
2. Replace the single result_committee_snapshot_hash in JobIntentV1, ResultVoteV1, ResultVoteSigningSubjectV1, SignOnceRecordV1 and all related exact-replay/signing preimages with the three explicit bindings result_validator_set_epoch, result_committee_set_hash and result_ocomp_binding_hash.
3. Change participant indices in new wire forms and vote slots from u8 to u16.
4. Make OcompVoteAccountabilityV1 dynamic: store N and quorum threshold, create exactly N Vec<Option<ResultVoteSlotV1>> slots, and keep the existing bounded O(N) quorum scan.
5. Replace u8 quorum/accountability bitmaps, including OcompQuorumV1 and OcompCompletedBindingV1, with bounded byte vectors of ceil(N/8). Normative order is LSB0: participant i uses byte floor(i/8), bit i mod 8; index 0 is the low bit of byte 0; unused high bits in the last byte must be zero.
6. Accountability remains monolithic and self-contained: job id, the three bindings, N, quorum threshold, slots, formed OcompQuorumV1 and closed summary. Do not add per-slot storage maps, tally caches, pruning or evidence caches.
7. Add one canonical bounded submitLysisResult ABI prefix decoder beside ResultVoteV1. The full canonical decoder must invoke it first. Stateful txpool/execution consumers will reuse this exact function in a later task.
8. Remove POC_COMMITTEE_SIZE and POC_COMMITTEE_THRESHOLD from semantic logic. POC_KEY_EPOCH may remain fixed at 1.

## Documentation owned by this task

- Rewrite docs/adr/system/ADR-S-OCM-003-deterministic-execution-and-quorum-evidence.md in place before the first production change. Do not create a new ADR and do not preserve fixed 4/q=3/four-slot membership as current or historical prose.

- Regenerated protocol registry/schema/preimage documentation is part of the same GREEN slices.

## Tests

- registration PoP rejects wrong chain, genesis, identity, key, epoch, purpose, high-S and malformed SEC1; exact canonical replay succeeds.
- dynamic accountability covers N=1 and representative N values through the current codec bound without literals in production OCOMP code.
- quorum vectors use the shared threshold supplied by the caller and cannot infer a different threshold.
- bitmap golden vectors cover indices 0, 7, 8, last participant and non-zero padding bits.
- all three snapshot bindings affect vote digest, sign-once record equality, quorum evidence and exact-retry/equivocation behavior.
- prefix decoder rejects truncated offsets, lengths, padding and oversized payloads without panic.

## Out of scope

No ValidatorSet storage, Metadosis state, node runtime, genesis or E2E changes in this issue.

title: Fix purpose-bound DcapRequired onboarding key delivery
description:
## Problem
Real production Validator and FullNode DcapRequired onboarding cannot complete. TeeRegistry emits the mandatory deterministic offer-key artifact after accepted RegisterEnclave, but the production enclave command matrix denies both SealOfferKeyForRegistry and IngestSealedOfferKeyForRegistry for every profile/readiness state, so execution becomes Fatal. This P0 is a prerequisite for the three focused lifecycle gaps, not a new lifecycle feature.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Start a production NodeHost-authorized Gramine enclave under a DcapRequired chain.
2. Submit valid canonical RegisterEnclave evidence with valid node and enclave signatures for a keyless Validator or FullNode.
3. Observe TeeRegistry call emit_offer_key_sealed_for_registry_v1.
4. Observe command_allowed reject FinalizedAuthorizationRequired and Registry map the failed mandatory seal to PrecompileError::Fatal.
5. Note that unit tests using emit_offer_key_sealed_for_registry_v1_after_sealer_for_test do not exercise this production matrix.

## Required Outcome
Implement the purpose-bound verify-and-seal and exact keyless ingest contract in P0 of outbe-plan/dcap-three-lifecycle-gaps-target-ru.md. Keep raw host-selected source sealing denied, preserve consensus byte determinism and context-separated AEAD derivation, accept only exact write-once target artifacts, and retain the documented exact-recipient reorg semantics without FinalityFollower or remote networking.
design: Follow P0 in outbe-plan/dcap-three-lifecycle-gaps-target-ru.md. Implement one purpose-bound DCAP verify-and-seal request whose commitment includes canonical evidence, active policy, consensus timestamp and node/enclave signatures. Its optional artifact is deterministic across OST3 holders. Derive key and nonce from context_hash and static-static shared secret using distinct ONBOARDING_KEY_INFO_V1 and ONBOARDING_NONCE_INFO_V1 constants; both must differ from each other, DKG_SHARE_INFO and REGISTRY_NONCE_INFO. Exact replay is byte-identical; different contexts for one recipient never reuse key/nonce. Target recomputes context, key and expected nonce from its recipient secret and exact offer public key; a serialized nonce is checked but never trusted or used as authority. Registry emits only the purpose-bound result; raw host-selected source sealing remains denied. No FinalityFollower or remote networking; the documented exact-recipient reorg semantic is accepted.
acceptance_criteria: Real DcapRequired Validator and FullNode join succeeds through the production command matrix; invalid evidence/signatures/recipient create no artifact; two OST3 source nodes return byte-identical exact artifacts; exact replay is identical and different context hashes for one recipient prove AEAD key/nonce separation; onboarding HKDF tags are pinned and distinct from every DKG/registry-seal domain; ingest recomputes expected nonce and rejects a modified wire nonce before AEAD open; raw source sealing remains denied; cross-chain/context/replay artifacts fail; existing key cannot be overwritten; crash/reopen and accepted reorg behavior are covered without claiming canonical admission.
notes:

EXTERNAL CRYPTO REVIEW 2026-08-03: accepted two mandatory refinements. Onboarding HKDF key/nonce tags are independent of DKG_SHARE_INFO and existing REGISTRY_NONCE_INFO. title: Deferred: mandatory FullNode Lysis follower before OCOMP testnet readiness
description:
## Goal

After dynamic membership is complete, add the separately scoped FullNode follower required for independent execution assurance. This is intentionally not part of the membership implementation epic.

## Target behavior

Every OCOMP-enabled FullNode independently consumes the same finalized intent and authenticated source bodies/proofs, executes the canonical Lysis program, materializes local chunks and expected Nod/output state, waits before accepting the quorum activation block, and compares its result digest, roots and manifest with the on-chain result. Missing bodies/proofs, compute failure or mismatch is fail-closed and observable.

## Why separate

Validator membership, historical vote authorization and key admission can be completed and tested without inventing a new full-node execution architecture. The follower is nevertheless required before declaring OCOMP testnet-ready because ordinary EVM replay alone cannot independently reconstruct off-chain Lysis outputs when source bodies are unavailable.

## Entry condition

Start only after outbe-chain-8ui and all membership children are complete. Reuse the final dynamic JobIntent snapshot bindings; do not redesign them.

## Acceptance

A FullNode independently recomputes a reachable Lysis job, obtains the same canonical result and materialized state, rejects a mismatching quorum result before applying it, and fails closed when required authenticated data is unavailable.

title: Resolve lease-expiry protected-output contract
description: Expiry correctly makes Registry readiness false and closes remote sessions, but local secret-bearing enclave commands remain authorized whenever the permanent offer key is resident. Decision-map #15 expects protocol outputs to stop at expiry, while the implementation plan explicitly defers protected-execution and consensus membership gating. Decide and specify the cross-module contract before implementation.
design: Do not remove a validator from the current BLS/DKG committee by a per-block timestamp filter. Current committee indices, quorum and threshold material are epoch-scoped. If continuous lease authority is required, define finalized proof delivery to secret commands and any membership effect only through the next finalized reshare/status transition. If testnet adopts Secret-Network-like one-time consensus admission, correct the lease claims instead of adding unsafe consensus wiring.
acceptance_criteria: One explicit decision states whether expiry governs only new registration/remote sessions or also protected outputs and future consensus eligibility; committee transition timing and finalized timestamp authority are defined; current-epoch quorum/DKG invariants are preserved; testnet blocking status and reachable tests are specified; no implementation starts until this decision is accepted.
notes: DECISION RESOLVED — 2026-08-03. Validator binding and exact EpochRoleGrant are immutable through the current epoch; mid-epoch lease expiry or policy cutoff closes generic sessions but exact epoch-scoped consensus, execution and explicitly granted DKG reconnect remain valid until the boundary. At the next freeze an expired binding becomes AttestationSuspended. If eligible threshold or DKG completion is insufficient, the next epoch does not activate and the network halts fail-closed; the old grant is not extended. FullNode has no epoch grant: expiry closes protected execution and serving, leaves only headers, bodies backlog, finality control and renewal, then normal executor catches up after finalized renewal. Security time is finalized consensus timestamp and consensus or peers independently validate accepted outputs.
